text: Switchboard 是 DSH Web 的 Telegram 与飞书聊天桥接插件，让用户从手机聊天窗口操作 Agent 会话。它通过 Host 的 Session controller 接入消息，并将回复、进度、文件和审批交互送回聊天。用户可切换或跟随会话、处理审批与问题、发送图片文件和语音，并在 Web 控制台管理线路。需配置 Telegram 机器人或飞书应用凭据。

Switchboard connects DSH Web sessions to Telegram and Feishu bots. It forwards chat messages to the host and returns replies, progress, files, and approval prompts. Users can switch or follow sessions and manage linked chats in the Web console. A bot or app credential is required.
想通过 Telegram 在手机上继续操作 DSH 会话。
能不能把飞书机器人接到 DSH，让我在聊天里给 Agent 发任务？
我想在聊天窗口查看 Agent 回复并实时看到进度。
希望在手机上处理 DSH 的工具审批和 Agent 提问。
如何把聊天里的照片、文件或语音发进当前会话？
想从飞书或 Telegram 切换到已有的 Web 会话。
I want to control my DSH agent sessions from Telegram on my phone.
Can I answer tool approval prompts from a Feishu chat?
I need chat messages and files to reach the current DSH session.
Switchboard 的功能「双平台聊天接入」：用户向 Telegram 或 Feishu/Lark 机器人发消息，插件将内容交给 DSH 会话，并把 Agent 回复送回聊天。。可从聊天消息或对应的会话操作触发。
Switchboard 的功能「会话切换与跟随」：通过聊天命令切换已有会话或跟随会话通知，也可在 Web composer 用 /switchboard 管理绑定。。可从聊天消息或对应的会话操作触发。
Switchboard 的功能「审批和问题交互」：聊天消息提供按钮以回应工具审批和 Agent 问题；插件将用户选择传回 Host 会话流程。。可从聊天消息或对应的会话操作触发。
Switchboard 的功能「媒体消息收发」：可将照片和文件交给会话，语音在语音识别服务可用时转录；Agent 展示的文件可回传聊天。。可从聊天消息或对应的会话操作触发。
Switchboard 会将聊天输入与 DSH 会话回复经 Telegram Bot API 或 Feishu/Lark Open Platform 传送；启用对应线路需要平台机器人或应用凭据。

dsh-switchboard README · Switchboard (dsh-switchboard)：English | [中文](README.zh.md) Command DeepSeek Harness Agents from your phone through Telegram and Feishu (Lark) bots: send the Agent text, photos, files, and voice notes, watch replies arrive as they are written, answer tool approvals and the Agent's questions, follow long tasks for completion notices, and browse every chat in the Web UI, where any Session can be linked to a chat.

dsh-switchboard README · Switchboard (dsh-switchboard)：The bots are other clients of the Web host. They create and prompt Sessions through `ctx.sessionController`, the same path the Web UI uses, so chat Sessions appear in the Web sidebar and Web Sessions can be taken over or followed. Sessions a bot creates go into the Web Workspace for their working directory (created on first use).

dsh-switchboard README · Lines：A **line** is one bot on one chat platform plus the people allowed to use it. Configure as many as you need, for example Telegram for yourself and Feishu for your team; each line has its own credentials, allowed users and chats, and default working directory. One Session can be linked to chats on several lines at once, and replies, approvals, and questions go to each of them. Chats are keyed `line:chat id` (for example `feishu:oc_xxx`); the original Telegram line (`telegram`) keeps bare ids, so bindings and history from earlier releases carry over. Supported: **Telegram** and **Feishu / Lark**.

dsh-switchboard README · Quick start：1. Install into a Web profile: **Plugins → Add plugin** with `dsh-switchboard`, or `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-switchboard`.
2. Open **Plugins → Installed → Switchboard** (or **Plugin settings** in the sidebar panel), add a line under **Lines**, fill in its credentials and **Allowed users** (send `/whoami` to the bot for your id), set the **Default working directory**, and **Save**. Changes apply immediately.

dsh-switchboard README · Quick start：**Telegram line**: create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) (`/newbot`), then **+ Telegram line** and paste the token. Allowed users are Telegram ids or `@usernames`.

**Feishu line**: Feishu delivers events over the Open Platform's persistent connection, so no public URL is needed.

dsh-switchboard README · Quick start：**By QR (recommended)**: **+ Feishu line** → **Create a Feishu app by QR**, scan with the Feishu app (or **Open in browser** on this computer), and confirm. The bot, permissions, the `im.message.receive_v1` event, and the `card.action.trigger` callback are filled in; the Host stores the App Secret in the credentials store (it never reaches the browser), the scanner is added to the allowed users, and the line is saved and connects. For an existing app, **Complete permissions** adds what is missing the same way.

dsh-switchboard README · Quick start：**By hand**:
1. On the [Feishu Open Platform](https://open.feishu.cn/app) (or [Lark](https://open.larksuite.com/app)) create a self-built app and add the **Bot** capability.
2. Grant `im:message.p2p_msg:readonly`, `im:message.group_at_msg:readonly`, `im:message:send_as_bot`, and `im:resource`; optionally `contact:user.base:readonly` (names) and `im:chat:readonly` (group names).
3. Add **+ Feishu line** with the **App ID** (`cli_…`) and **App Secret** and save: Feishu lets you pick the persistent connection only while a client is connected.
4. Under **Events and callbacks**, choose **Receive events through persistent connection** and add the event `im.message.receive_v1`; do the same for callbacks and add `card.action.trigger` (buttons need it).
5. Publish a version, message the bot `/whoami`, and add the open_id it replies with (`ou_…`, per app; user_id and union_id also match) to the line's allowed users.

dsh-switchboard README · Quick start：Feishu has no typing indicator or command menu; everything else matches Telegram. Replies, drafts, tool activity, and messages with buttons are interactive cards updated in place; notices are text messages.

dsh-switchboard README · In the chat：| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| text, photo, file, voice | Goes to the current Session; one is started in the default directory if needed |
| `/menu` | Buttons for common actions (new session, sessions, model, mode, stop, compact, status, help); the easiest way in Feishu |
| `/new [dir]` | New Session; without a directory, pick the default or a recent one |
| `/cwd <dir>` | Working directory for this chat's new Sessions |
| `/sessions` | Recent Sessions with titles, as buttons that switch |
| `/use <n\|sessionId>` | Switch to an existing Session (Web ones too) |
| `/watch [n\|sessionId]` | Follow a Session's completions and approvals; no argument lists them |
| `/unwatch <n\|sessionId\|all>` | Stop following |
| `/stop` | Stop current work |
| `/steer <text>` | Steer the running turn |
| `/queue`, `/cancel <n\|all>` | Show or drop queued messages |
| `/model [name]` | Show or switch the Session's model (buttons, fuzzy match; the Web default is untouched) |
| `/mode [mode]` | Show or switch the Session's permission mode |
| `/get <path>` | Fetch a file or list a directory inside the working directory (symlinks cannot escape it) |
| `/fork` |

dsh-switchboard README · In the chat：- **Rendering**: Markdown becomes Telegram HTML (with a plain-text fallback) or a Feishu card's Markdown, split safely.
- **One progress message**: while a turn runs, a single "⏳ Working · time · N tool calls" message shows the latest tool calls and the reply being written, with a **⏹ Stop** button, and steps aside when the reply arrives as a new message at the bottom (so it notifies): deleted on Telegram, shrunk to a one-line summary on Feishu; a stop or failure is told there too.
- **Acknowledged at once**: your message gets 👀 (Feishu: OnIt) while it is worked on, cleared when done; a message sent during a running turn gets a "Queued" notice with **Steer now** and **Cancel**.
- **Buttons under the reply**: **Continue**, **Retry**, **Show changes** (the turn's changes as a diff file, new files included), and **New session**; they move to the next reply.
- **Turn summaries**: duration, tool calls, and changed files after long turns (configurable).
- **Context and long content**: replying to (quoting) a message sends its text along. Replies over **Long reply as a file** (6000 characters) arrive as a preview plus a Markdown file; Feishu cards fold

dsh-switchboard README · In the Web UI：- **Switchboard console** (sidebar), four tabs: **Chats** (every line's chats, an overview with a 14-day chart, full threads with **Open Session**); **Lines** (one-line summaries that open for editing, Feishu added by QR); **Members** (people waiting for approval, allowed with one click and told so, and everyone allowed per line); **Settings** (common options first, the rest under **Advanced**).
- **Switchboard tab in every Session**: linked chats on any line, bind or follow another chat, send as the bot, and the Session's chat activity. **Continue on your phone** shows a QR code: scan it and that chat takes over the Session, or send the bot `/link <code>`. A code works once, for 10 minutes, and only for a line's allowed users. On Feishu the QR only opens the bot, so send the code there.
- **`/switchboard` in the composer**: `bind`, `watch`, `unbind`, and `send` for the open Session.
- **Channel note**: Sessions bound to a chat get a short note asking for phone-friendly replies.
dsh-switchboard README · Models：A `/model` choice for the Session > the plugin page's **Bot default model** for Sessions a bot creates > the Web default. Neither changes the Web default.

dsh-switchboard README · Configuration：See the full tables in [README.zh.md](README.zh.md#配置项). `lines` holds the lines; while it is empty, the Telegram fields of earlier releases (`botTokenRef`, `allowedUsers`, …) run as the `telegram` line, and the plugin page writes them to `lines` on its next save. `pollTimeoutSec` and `stateFile` live in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Set `HTTPS_PROXY` before launching `dsh` if the platforms are not directly reachable. Migrating from `dsh-telegram-bridge`: see [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md).

dsh-switchboard README · Adding a channel：Implement the `Channel` interface in `src/channels/types.ts`, register the type in `lines.ts` and in `startLine` in `bridge.ts`, and give it credential fields in the settings page's line editor.

dsh-switchboard README · Development：Type-checking and the Loader composition test use a built sibling checkout at `../deepseek-harness`.

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

See [docs/PUBLISHING.md](docs/PUBLISHING.md) for npm publishing and [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for changes.
